title: Engineering All-Hands 2026-03-04
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Time: 09:00 - 10:00 PT
Location: All-hands Zoom (recording posted in #eng-all)
Attendees: ~120 eng org (see attendance sheet), leads: Priya Kumar (host), Marcus Patel, Ava Chen, Diego Rivera, Lena Sørensen, Yusuf Ibrahim

Agenda:
- Quick metrics & highlights (5m)
- Team updates (20m)
  - Serving Runtime
  - Platform & Infra
  - Observability + Console
  - Private Deployments
- Incidents & reliability updates (10m)
- Roadmap signals & upcoming releases (15m)
- Q&A / open items (10m)

Key announcements:
- Serving Runtime v1.8 rollout plan approved; canary starts 2026-03-06 targeting 10% traffic on Dedicated pool A. Full rollout contingent on canary metrics (latency p95 < 180ms, error rate < 0.2%).
- Dedicated capacity expansion: added 8x A100 nodes to us-west-2 cluster to support Q2 committed customers; expected available capacity 2026-03-10.
- Private deployment beta: first on-prem customer (FinRegCo) completed security review; seat license agreement signed, on-prem deploy scheduled 2026-03-22.

Quick metrics & highlights (Priya):
- Overall API token throughput: 1.2B tokens/day (+12% week-over-week).
- Hosted average latency (text-gen): p50=55ms, p95=170ms (slight uptick due to higher seq length mix).
- Cost: effective cost-per-1M-tokens stable; Optimize suggestions reduced cost by 8% for top 5 customers on pilot.

Team updates:
- Serving Runtime (Marcus):
  - v1.8 includes dynamic KV cache sharding and patch for attention kernel fallback that reduced OOMs in long-context runs.
  - Stress testing results: stable at 2.5x nominal throughput with degraded-latency profile acceptable for background batch jobs.
  - Immediate ask: solutions-eng to provide 3 customer prompt traces for canary test (Marcus, due 2026-03-05).

- Platform & Infra (Diego):
  - Autoscaler improvements merged; burst policy now respects reserved capacity tiers.
  - Rolling update automation: reduced median update time from 22m -> 9m in staging.
  - Storage migration for KV cache: starting dry-run rollout 2026-03-08; small risk window, infra to post detailed runbook.

- Observability & Console (Ava):
  - New per-route cost breakdown dashboard in console internal preview; will enable token-level attribution to model+route.
  - Trace sampling adjustments rolled out to prod (lower noise on high-volume customers while retaining error fidelity).
  - Action: product + analytics to align on which cost alerts should be public-facing (Ava/Product, due 2026-03-11).

- Private Deployments (Lena):
  - On-prem packaging release candidate ready; encryption-at-rest with customer KMS integration validated in staging.
  - Compliance: SOC2 readiness checklist updated; external audit scheduled for April.

Incidents & reliability (Yusuf):
- Incident summary (2026-02-28): partial degradation in us-east model pool due to driver-level mismatch after a kernel optimization rollout. Root cause: mismatched CUDA runtime between nodes. Mitigation: immediate rollback + pinning of runtime; postmortem published (link in #eng-incident).
- Follow-ups: add runtime compatibility gating to release pipeline; infra to enforce image smoke-tests (Yusuf/Diego, due 2026-03-09).

Roadmap & upcoming releases:
- March priorities: finish v1.8 canary and decision gate by 2026-03-12; finish dedicated capacity expansion; ship console per-route cost UI to closed beta by end of March.
- Q2 preview: focus on multi-region smart routing, improved quantization profiles in Optimize, and a pilot for low-latency (<100ms p95) offering for enterprise customers.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marcus: collect 3 customer prompt traces for canary testing — 2026-03-05.
- Yusuf & Diego: add runtime compatibility gating + smoke-tests to CI — 2026-03-09.
- Ava/Product: decide public-facing cost alert set and staging thresholds — 2026-03-11.
- Lena: finalize on-prem packaging docs & deploy runbook for FinRegCo — 2026-03-18.
- Priya: schedule cross-functional post-canary review and publish decision checklist — 2026-03-12.

Parking lot / questions raised in Q&A:
- "What happens if canary shows higher p95 on long-context customers?" — plan: automatic rollback + preserve older model variant as fallback; rollouts will be paused and we will run targeted debug traces with the customer.
- "Any update on our plan to expose token-level billing usage to finance?" — Ava: working with finance on CSV export; expected beta March-end.

Notes to leads / follow-ups:
- Please keep standup threads short and linked to JIRA tickets; for cross-team coordination, use the cross-team board we've created (JIRA-1428).
- If you see any customer-reported regressions during canary, escalate via #eng-incident and ping Yusuf directly.

Attachments / links:
- Postmortem: confluence/INC-2026-02-28-runtime-oom
- Canary checklist: confluence/CANARY-2026-v1.8
- Recording + slides: drive/eng-all-hands/2026-03-04/recording.mp4

Next all-hands: 2026-03-18 (biweekly)

---
Notes (informal): rough transcript from meeting + action items captured by Priya. Will sync with leads for any edits before publishing to company wiki.
